samples.heard: Remember these, O Jacob and Israel, for thou art my servant.  I have formed thee, thou art my servant, O Israel, thou shalt not be forgotten of me.

samples.text: And the glory of the God of Israel was gone up from the cherub, whereupon he was, to the threshold of the house. And he called to the man clothed with linen, which had the writer’s inkhorn by his side;
samples.heard: And the glory of the God of Israel was gone up from the cherub, whereupon he was, to the threshold of the house.  And he called to the man clothed with linen, which had the writer's ink horn by his side.

samples.text: So Joshua let the people depart, every man unto his inheritance.
samples.heard: So Joshua let the people depart.  Every man unto his inheritance.

samples.text: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:
samples.heard: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth, I tell you, nay, but rather division.

samples.text: And now will I discover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and none shall deliver her out of mine hand.
samples.heard: And now will I discover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers,  and none shall deliver her out of mine hand.

samples.text: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.
samples.heard: And the king said,  Bring me a sword.  And they brought a sword before the king.

samples.text: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.
samples.heard: of the sons of Uzil, Mecha, of the sons of Misha, Shemya.

samples.text: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest:
samples.heard: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the Lord,  A ram without blemish out of the flock,  With thy estimation,  For a trespass offering unto the priest.

samples.text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his fathers had done.
samples.heard: And he did that which which was evil in the sight of the Lord.  According to all that his fathers had done.

samples.text: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
samples.heard: Likewise from Tebhath and from Chun, cities of Haderiza brought David very much brass,  wherewith Solomon made the Bracency and the Pillars and the vessels of brass.

samples.text: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country, and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.
samples.heard: An Abraham journeyed from Thence toward the South Country  and dwelt between Cadish and Sher, and sojourned in Jerar.

samples.text: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither hath he covered the darkness from my face.
samples.heard: because I was not cut off before the darkness.  Neither hath he covered the darkness from my face.

samples.text: And they cried out again, Crucify him.
